purpose: 长期 AI 协作文章的三张说明图

prompts.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create ONE polished editorial educational infographic for a Chinese technical article about long-horizon AI work. Landscape 16:9, white background, ample whitespace, crisp restrained flat illustration and precise connectors, dark navy Chinese sans-serif type, muted blue and teal, amber only for uncertainty. No logos, no decorative robots, no invented metrics, no small print. All labels must be Simplified Chinese, legible and exactly as quoted. Do not include any text beyond specified labels. This is an explanatory article diagram, not advertising. Theme: distinguish historical material from current authoritative task state and task-scoped input. Title exactly “从历史记录到当前依据”. Left: a neat stack of documents labelled “提议”, “尝试”, “失败”, “修订”, collectively heading “历史记录”. A clear rightward arrow labelled “确认有效内容” leads to a central blue document card headed “当前状态”, containing four lines “目标与约束”, “有效决定”, “产物与验证”, “未完成事项”. Another arrow right labelled “按需选择” leads to a tidy teal folder headed “本次任务”, inside two lines “相关依据”, “证据入口”. Keep all three regions distinct; history is preserved, never portray history being deleted or all prior messages simply poured into a model. Center title above the diagram. Large readable labels, balanced generous spacing.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Create ONE polished editorial educational infographic for a Chinese technical article about long-horizon AI work. Landscape 16:9, white background, ample whitespace, crisp restrained flat illustration and precise connectors, dark navy Chinese sans-serif type, muted blue and teal, amber only for uncertainty. No logos, no decorative robots, no invented metrics, no small print. All labels must be Simplified Chinese, legible and exactly as quoted. Do not include any text beyond specified labels. This is an explanatory article diagram, not advertising. Theme: accepted task output must be verified before becoming basis of later work. Title “从候选到可依赖的结果”. Main horizontal flow across the middle has five equal clean cards with arrows strictly left to right: “当前依据” then “任务合同” then “实施候选” then “验证” then “更新状态”. Under verification card, amber downward branch labelled “失败或未知” leads to a small amber card “保留问题并返工”, then return connector to “实施候选” along bottom. The arrow from “验证” to “更新状态” is teal and labelled “满足验收条件”. From “更新状态” a teal short arrow leads to bottom-right small label “下一步依据”. Show successful transition contingent on verification. Every line of text large; no giant paragraph or extra ornament.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Create ONE polished editorial educational infographic for a Chinese technical article about long-horizon AI work. Landscape 16:9, white background, ample whitespace, crisp restrained flat illustration and precise connectors, dark navy Chinese sans-serif type, muted blue and teal, amber only for uncertainty. No logos, no decorative robots, no invented metrics, no small print. All labels must be Simplified Chinese, legible and exactly as quoted. Do not include any text beyond specified labels. This is an explanatory article diagram, not advertising. Theme: route changes do not remove acceptance obligations in a software migration. Title “路线改变，验收要求继续承接”. Top full-width dark navy outline banner headed “迁移目标” with three equal label chips “保持原行为”, “回归测试”, “真实环境验证”. Below: left blue card “原方案” leads downward to small amber label “方案失败”, then a bent arrow points to right teal card “替代方案”. From the top banner, clear teal downward connectors indicate the SAME three requirements apply to the replacement route. Under replacement card show a three-row status checklist: “保持原行为” with green check icon, “回归测试” with green check icon, “真实环境验证” with amber question-mark icon. Bottom-right amber outlined badge “仍未满足交付条件”. Use strong layout hierarchy, no connector crossing text, no red completion badge, do not claim unknown verification passed.
